relationship.statement: These six proposed plates supplement the preserved evidence for the 104 approved comparisons.

sourceScope: Six source-specific Sinaiticus readings; not a complete apparatus or an originality judgment.

candidate-105.title: Codex Sinaiticus at Matthew 20:16

images.alt: Complete facsimile page of Codex Sinaiticus, local folio 211, containing Matthew 20:16.

candidate-105.caption: Codex Sinaiticus (GA 01/א), British Library Add MS 43725, local folio 211; Matthew 20:16 col. 2, line 12. The first-hand verse ends with the reversal of first and last; the additional saying about many called and few chosen is not in the verse record.
candidate-105.demonstrates: The facsimile page and official transcription permit inspection of this witness's reading and recorded corrections in their page context.
candidate-105.doesNotEstablish: This single witness does not by itself establish the autograph reading, the reading of any other manuscript, or the relative weight of the alternatives.
candidate-105.credit: Image via CSNTM from the J. T. and Zelma Luther Archives, A. Webb Roberts Library, Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary; manuscript held by the British Library, Add MS 43725. Transcription verification: Codex Sinaiticus Project.
candidate-105.reuseStatement: Prepared under the project owner’s recorded September 12, 2026 authorization for free educational Ad Fontes web and offline desktop distribution. This candidate has no publication approval and grants no broader image reuse.

candidate-107.title: Codex Sinaiticus at John 1:28

images.alt: Complete facsimile page of Codex Sinaiticus, local folio 247, containing John 1:28.

candidate-107.caption: Codex Sinaiticus (GA 01/א), British Library Add MS 43725, local folio 247; John 1:28 col. 3, line 38. The first hand reads βηθανια (Bethany); corrector cb2 changes the name to βηθαραβα. The correction's exact spelling is preserved rather than normalized to the displayed TR form.

candidate-109.caption: Codex Sinaiticus (GA 01/א), British Library Add MS 43725, local folio 289; Hebrews 2:9 col. 3, line 6. The first hand reads χαριτι followed by the nomen sacrum for God, corresponding to 'by the grace of God'; it does not supply the apart-from-God alternative.
